page.overview:
What is Stefan Skellen's gang?

Stefan Skellen's gang consisted of various mercenaries, thieves, and bandits from across the region. While the purpose was for Stefan Skellen to hunt down and capture Ciri on Emperor Emhyr var Emreis' orders, this wasn't relayed to most of the gang members, only that they were looking for a certain girl.

Members of the gang were recruited by Dacre Silifant, Ola Harsheim and Bert Brigden and they were then brought on the 14 September at Rocayne, where Stefan Skellen was waiting. Unbeknownst to Skellen, there were two traitors among his group: Neratin Ceka, having been planted by Skellen's boss Vattier de Rideaux, and Jediah Mekesser, who was a spy for the sorceress Assire var Anahid.

The first task of the gang was to investigate on what Leo Bonhart did after he slaughtered the Rats with the exception of Falka in Jealousy: Nycklar, a young boy hired to Bonhart to deliver some letter, was captured from Malhoun and was brought to Rocayne, where Stefan Skellen interrogated him; it turned out that the letters Nyclar delivered were addressed to Esterhazy of Fano and to Dominik Bombastus Houvenaghel of Claremont.

On 16 September Boreas Mun, Neratin Ceka, Chloe Stitz, Andres Vierny, Cyprian Fripp, Dede Vargas and Joanna Selborne went to Fano and interrogated Esterhazy, the local weaponsmith. Esterhazy told them that Bonhart and Ciri were here four days before and that Bonhart bought a sword for Ciri.
